subject: Sweep schedule and VAT documentation request — June invoice
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Elena Mirov <elena.mirov@novaforge.com>, Novaforge AP <ap@novaforge.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sweep schedule and VAT documentation request — June invoice

Hi Elena / AP team,

Following up on Invoice REDWOOD_2027-06-30 (attached). Novaforge is showing as outstanding on our ledger and we wanted to confirm your preferred settle path and any EU VAT evidence you need to release the ACH.

Quick context and asks:
- Amount: EUR 48,360.00 (invoice attached).
- Preferred routing: ACH/EU same-day wire is best for both sides; if you need a credit-card fallback we can accept that but it will normally incur a processing surcharge unless we agree a one-time waiver.
- VAT: AP mentioned they need a certificate on company letterhead for EU VAT reclaim. If you can share the signed VAT certificate (or confirm Redwood’s VAT number below), AP can proceed. Our VAT: IE3579874B (Redwood Inference EMEA Ltd).
- Bank cutoff: please confirm the latest time your bank needs to originate a transfer for same-day value (we typically see 15:00 CET as the practical cutoff).

Attachments: Invoice_REDWOOD_2027-06-30.pdf (PDF) — included for reference.

Can you please:
1) Confirm whether AP will pay by ACH/wire and the latest cutoff for same-day value,
2) Confirm whether you need the VAT certificate template filled (I’ve CC’d Lauren from finance who can provide),
3) If ACH isn’t possible, confirm whether we should proceed with CC fallback and whom to invoice there.

If you prefer a quick call, I’m available between 09:30–12:00 BST today.

Thanks,

--
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0192

Attachment: Invoice_REDWOOD_2027-06-30.pdf (PDF, 72KB)

From: Elena Mirov <elena.mirov@novaforge.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Novaforge AP <ap@novaforge.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 17:04:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Sweep schedule and VAT documentation request — June invoice

Thanks Rohan — apologies for the delay. AP is looped in.

A few answers from our side:
- AP preference: bank transfer (EUR SEPA/wire). ACH equivalent for EUR is fine but we need confirmation of the beneficiary VAT details for our records before release.
- VAT certificate: we need a company VAT certificate showing Redwood’s name and VAT number (signed). If you can fill the attached template and return to ap@novaforge.com we can route to taxation and release payment.
- Bank cutoff: our treasury confirmed that transfers initiated by 16:00 CET typically reach beneficiary bank same day; anything after 16:00 CET is processed next business day.

We can accept CC fallback but need to know the projected fee and whether Redwood will absorb the cost. Can you/your finance confirm?

Elena
Finance Manager — Novaforge
elena.mirov@novaforge.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sweep schedule and VAT documentation request — June invoice

Hi Elena / AP team — looping in Finance.

Thanks for the quick clarifications. A few items from our side to make the payment flow smooth:
1) VAT evidence: I’ve attached a short VAT certificate template (VAT_Cert_Req_Form.xlsx). Please complete the buyer fields and sign the document. Once we receive the signed certificate, our AP team will mark the invoice as ready for payment.

2) Bank cutoff / settlement expectations: for EUR wires to our EMEA clearing account we recommend initiation by 12:00 UTC (13:00 CET) to ensure beneficiary posting same business day in our bank. I appreciate Novaforge’s treasury guidance — we’ll take 16:00 CET as your internal cutoff; to align both sides, please aim to originate the transfer by 13:00 CET / 12:00 UTC if same-day settlement is required.

3) Card fallback: Redwood can accept a card payment if needed. Standard processing fee is 2.9% + €0.30. For this instance, given the size and relationship, we can offer a one-time partial fee waiver of 1% if Novaforge accepts card fallback and confirms by EOD July 22. Otherwise we will apply standard fees.

4) Bank reference: please include invoice number as payment reference (REDWOOD_INV_2027-06-30) so reconciliation is automatic. If Novaforge can also provide the sending bank reference after initiation we will reconcile faster.

Action items:
- Elena/AP: return the completed VAT_Cert_Req_Form.xlsx to ap@novaforge.com and cc neha.kapoor@redwood.com
- Rohan: follow up with Elena on card fallback decision if ACH timing will miss the coordinated window.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call to coordinate if useful.

Best,

--
Lauren Bishop
VP, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Attachment: VAT_Cert_Req_Form.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>

Thanks Elena — and thanks Lauren for the template.

Elena / AP team — quick next steps and commitments from Redwood:
- We’ve attached the invoice again and included the VAT template Lauren provided. If you can return the completed VAT certificate by end of day tomorrow (Fri 23 Jul) and initiate transfer by 13:00 CET / 12:00 UTC, we’ll target same-day posting on our side and close the ledger for this period.
- If ACH/wire cannot be originated by your 13:00 CET initiation window, please confirm whether Novaforge wants us to process card fallback. If you choose card fallback and confirm by EOD Jul 22, Redwood will apply a one-time partial fee waiver (1%). After EOD Jul 22 we’ll revert to standard fees.
- Please include REDWOOD_INV_2027-06-30 as the payment reference and send the bank transaction ref once initiated to ap@novaforge.com and cc neha.kapoor@redwood.com for fast reconciliation.

I’ll follow up Friday morning EMEA time if I haven’t seen the certificate. Appreciate the quick turnaround — want to make this painless for both AP teams.

Regards,

--
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
